# Saturday litter picks

- We meet at the church gate at 9 am on the first Saturday of each month and pick for two hours.
- Turnout: 14 people in September, 11 in October, 9 in November, 6 in December.
- The council lends us grabbers, hoops and bags, and collects the full bags on Monday.
- Most people who come are retired. Two families with children came in September but not since.
- We post the date on the village noticeboard a week before. There is no social media page.
- After the pick everyone goes home. Last year someone suggested coffee afterwards, but nobody organised it.
